checkpoint_tie_break: Within 1e-6, lower unweighted validation cross-entropy, then earlier epoch
pending_recipe_screen: residual177_weighted_seed434: finish the same declared 48-epoch maximum/early-stop procedure
already_rejected: residual177_bn_seed434: no validation benefit; learned weights unchanged
longer_budget_rule: After the matched screen, extend only the leading recipe to at most 64 cumulative epochs if its best checkpoint falls within the last 10 completed epochs or its best macro-F1 improved by at least 0.005 during that interval. Keep the original run intact; preserve exact last model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG state. Retain the same early stop and selection rule.
stability_rule: Train seed 435 from fresh weights using the leading recipe after the duration check, with the same full train/validation splits, preprocessing, and declared budget. Report the two initialization results as limited stability evidence, not significance. Select the deliverable by validation, not seed identity.
stopping_rule: Conclude this bounded local search after the controlled architecture/loss comparisons, one duration check when justified and one additional initialization. This is about five hours of active accelerator work at the measured throughput plus diagnostics; it is a practical student-project budget, not a global optimum. Remaining rare-label, source/annotation and independent-field-data gaps are documented future work.
fresh_data_decision: Keep the already audited release for comparable experiments. Rare classes need verified compatible examples and expert labels; no unverified web downloads or generated evaluation evidence are introduced.
confidence_policy: No fitted threshold or calibration; display uncalibrated softmax scores with limitations.

amendments.trigger: User explicitly confirmed no hard deadline and requested the strongest defensible result; no test predictions have been inspected.
amendments.change: After the current 128-pixel seed check, benchmark and test one 160-pixel resolution recipe using the same compact residual architecture, full training split, weighting, seed434 and maximum64/early-stop settings. Fit its normalization on training pixels only.
amendments.hypothesis: 128-pixel resizing can discard small lesion detail. A modest resolution increase may improve validation recognition without adding trainable parameters.
amendments.cost_rule: Use an actual short benchmark to confirm practical local runtime. Stop this dimension at160 pixels; do not launch an open-ended resolution/architecture grid.
amendments.decision_rule: Use the same validation macro-F1/loss selection. Compare the 160-pixel seed434 result with its 128-pixel counterpart and the observed 128-pixel seed variation. Repeat160 with seed435 if it offers a meaningful gain relative to that variation and local cost is practical.
amendments.stopping_rule: Finalize after this resolution check and any justified stability repeat; if gains are negligible, retain the strongest already verified artifact. Remaining annotation, rare-label and independent-field-data work stays future work.
amendments.paired_resolution_decision: If seed434 at160 improves macro-F1 by at least max(0.005, observed128-seed range), repeat160 with435. Select160 only if its two-seed mean selected-checkpoint macro-F1 exceeds the128 two-seed mean by at least0.005; otherwise prefer128 for its lower compute cost. This configuration acceptance rule is declared before any160 validation results. Within the accepted recipe select the saved checkpoint by macro-F1, then the existing loss/earlier-epoch tie break.

amendments.invariants: All177 classes; random initialization for fresh recipes; same frozen split membership; training-only fitted statistics; no test predictions until configuration/checkpoint selection is complete; no paid resources or external data publication implied.
amendments.stopping_rule: Conclude when targeted changes no longer produce reproducible, practically meaningful validation macro-F1 gains beyond seed variation, learning curves have plateaued with the planned schedule, and the remaining bottlenecks are data/annotation/representativeness rather than a supported model change. Document the evidence; do not claim global optimality.

The earlier cost-driven160 acceptance threshold is superseded.
amendments.next_controlled_trial: After choosing the competitive resolution recipe, test dihedral_color versus dihedral, holding architecture, split, class weighting, seed and schedule fixed. Brightness and contrast range0.9–1.1; no hue shifts or crops.
amendments.hypothesis: Persistently larger training than validation macro-F1 and weaker varied-scene validation strata justify testing mild illumination variation before increasing capacity. Source strata have different class compositions, so this does not assert a proven causal background shortcut.
amendments.repeat_rule: Repeat a promising augmentation recipe with seed435. Preserve all reference checkpoints, report both seed results, and select using validation only. No test predictions until the search stops and artifacts are frozen.

amendments.next_conditional_trial: After the mild-illumination screen and any justified repeat, test AdamW weight_decay=0.001 versus 0.0001 on the leading supported resolution/augmentation recipe. Hold all other numeric settings fixed and initialize seed434 from scratch.
amendments.validation_evidence: Completed weighted recipes have training macro-F1 about0.87–0.88 and validation macro-F1 about0.60 after learning-rate reduction. This supports a controlled stronger-regularization trial; losses with and without class weights are not directly compared.
amendments.hypothesis: Moderately stronger weight decay may reduce fitting of unstable training-specific features without discarding lesion information.
amendments.acceptance: Repeat a promising improvement with seed435; compare paired-seed means, accuracy, loss and class support. Small changes relative to observed initialization variability remain tentative.
amendments.stopping_evidence: If illumination and stronger weight decay fail to produce a reproducible validation improvement after the completed resolution comparison, stop this regularization branch. Additional model complexity requires new validation evidence rather than the absence of a time limit. Final test stays sealed.
